# SyncLab — Machine-Readable Systems Specification
> Canonical context file for LLMs, evaluation bots, and autonomous coding agents.

## Project Summary
- Project: SyncLab
- Purpose: Real-Time Collaborative WebRTC Code & Architecture Whiteboard Sandbox.
- Target Competition: "BUiLDX (Code-A-Nova)" on Unstop.
- Primary Stack: Python 3.10+, Sequence CRDTs (Conflict-Free Replicated Data Types), WebRTC Presence, Ephemeral Sandboxed Subprocesses.
- Repository Root: .

## Core System Modules
1. `core/crdt_doc.py`:
   - Operation-based sequence Conflict-Free Replicated Data Type.
   - Guarantees strong eventual consistency: multiple distributed peers type concurrently with deterministic order resolution and zero merge conflicts.
2. `core/canvas_sync.py`:
   - Real-time vector diagramming engine for architecture sketching.
   - Synchronizes 2D nodes, directional arrows, and $(x, y)$ collaborator cursor presence.
3. `core/sandbox.py`:
   - Ephemeral subprocess code runner with strict execution timeouts (5s) and captured standard streams (`stdout`/`stderr`).
4. `core/server.py`:
   - Central room state hub coordinating text CRDT documents, canvas snapshots, and execution queues.
5. `app/main.py`:
   - Interactive CLI simulating distributed multi-peer concurrent editing, vector diagramming, and sandbox execution.

## Self-Test / Demo Execution
Run `python3 app/main.py` to trigger concurrent multi-peer CRDT text convergence, vector canvas sync, and sandboxed execution.
